mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which is a precursor to an economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% within two months signals a supply-side contraction, which leads to lower corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% within two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3% within a month signals a strengthening labor market, which is a precursor to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals inflationary pressure coupled with tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter, it signals strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and GDPC1 grows > 2% QoQ
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 70% of triggered instances despite the positive signal.
